# Oil pan and starter access

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Remove the front differential by unbolting the propeller shaft from its center. [t1065]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Remove the front differential by unbolting the propeller shaft from its center.
2. Unbolt the half-shafts connecting the wheels to the differential assembly.
3. [Partial] Detach the bolts securing the front cross-member mounts, removing one side and unbolted or cutting the other if needed for clearance.
4. Remove the rear cross-member mounting bolts while supporting the differential with a jack.
5. Disconnect the vent tube from the differential by pinching its hose clamp and wiggling it off.
6. Rotate the front of the differential downward so the input shaft points nearly straight down to clear the oil pan area.
7. [Partial] Lower the entire differential assembly out from under the vehicle.

_Procedure reported by [t1065]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.xterranation.org/index.php?threads/how-to-oil-pan-removal-to-fix-oil-leak-at-rear-of-oil-pan-that-kills-starters.11018/>_

## Tools

- Flare wrench with cheater bar [t1065]
- MAPP gas torch (or larger propane) [t1065]
- [Partial] 6-point box end wrench [t1065]
- Impact wrench with socket and extension [t1065]
- Dead blow hammer [t1065]
- Long extension for u-joint access [t1065]

## Parts

- [Partial] Nissan oil pan side gasket insert, left/right (14746-12G10) [t1065]
- [Partial] Nissan oil pan side gasket insert, right/left (14746-12G11) [t1065]

## Specifications

- **Oil pan bolt size**: 10mm [t1065] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Propeller shaft nut heating time per side**: 15 to 20 seconds [t1065] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Use MAPP gas for a hotter flame when breaking loose red-Loctited nuts. [t1065]
- Heat one side of the propeller shaft nut, wait, then heat the opposite side before wrenching. [t1065]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Using a small torch that didn't generate enough heat to break loose factory Loctite quickly. [t1065]
